item.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
item.description: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

item.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
item.description: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.

item.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
